note: 资产定义。2026-08-17 按 Andy 给的三张参考图重做：风格从赛璐璐平涂改成高精度 CG 渲染。**质感差的两个真因**：一是风格定错，二是 24 格挤一张图每格只剩一百多像素。现在每张 sheet 最多 6 格、2048×2048，每格约 680px；另出一张定妆图判质感。 2026-08-17 补 VFX：特效之前一个资产都没有，全靠 prompt 文字，而文字锁不住外观 —— 护盾三档读数是观众判断战况的唯一依据，没有资产等于没写。**黑底不是透明底**：Seedream 只返回 JPEG，没有 alpha 通道，能量特效本来就走加色/滤色合成，黑底在 screen 下等价于透明且比抠图干净。配色跟实际定妆图走：艾琳是黑金不是蓝（设定集文字过时了），雷昂是赤红。 2026-08-17 特效返工：(1) 尺度按 Andy「巨大杀伤范围、炸裂效果、鲜艳彩色、夸张动作」全面上调，每个爆开态必须画出三层（过曝白热核／饱和本色／冲击波环＋碎屑速度线）；(2) 艾琳系改回**电蓝→青白**，不是金 —— 分镜逐秒稿写的是蓝，而且金配红都是暖色，红蓝对立这条视觉主轴用金撑不起来；她的**铠甲**仍是黑金，改的是她的**法术**颜色，两者不冲突；(3) 特效风格串从角色串里分出来（`styles.vfx`）；(4) 成品是 RGBA 透明底，黑底只是出图中间态。
style: ultra detailed 3D CG render, cinematic key light with strong rim light separating the figure, ornate layered fantasy armour with filigree and glowing inlays, volumetric energy particles and embers in the air, deep blacks with high dynamic range, sharp micro detail on metal, cloth and leather, artstation quality character art.

assets.retry: 第二版。第一版把连续的场景几何画了进来（剑气：石柱＋石地；光弹：一把剑刃；法阵：整块石板地；地裂：满幅石板地），这种东西抠不成 alpha —— 地面整块跟着进来，叠到真神殿上就是两层地板，光弹那格还会多出第二把剑。改成正面写「悬在空中、四周是空黑」，**一个否定词都没加** —— 靠说要什么，不靠说不要什么。

sheet_bg: The figure stands on a flat neutral dark grey backdrop lit evenly enough to read every detail, with clean gutters of equal width between the cells.
hero_bg: The figure stands alone on a near black backdrop, lit by a strong rim light from behind and one soft key from the front, energy particles drifting through the air around it, full body inside the frame, vertical composition.
vfx_bg: Every panel sits on a solid pure black field so the effect can be keyed to transparency and composited with an additive screen blend. Each panel holds one effect by itself: the effect and the debris thrown out of it hang free in mid air, with flat empty black behind them, beneath them and out to every border of the panel, and the glow falling off smoothly into that black. The whole picture is made of light, sparks and flying fragments, drawn as a free floating overlay element for compositing. Clean gutters of equal width separate the panels.

styles.vfx: japanese anime battle effect plate, drawn as a bold graphic shape with a crisp hard outer edge and two step cel shading inside it, a blown out white hot core reading as pure white, a heavily saturated colour body around that core, and an expanding flat shockwave ring at the outer rim; radial speed lines rake outward, and debris shards, light grains and sparks fly out along them with stretched motion trails; exaggerated sakuga dynamics with elongated forms and whip like tails; extreme contrast, luminous, vivid, high energy.
